WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT o.weathprofile, t.bandusagepct
  FROM telescopes t
  INNER JOIN observatories o ON o.observstation = t.observstation
  WHERE t.detecttempk > 152.1
),
profile_stats AS (
  SELECT weathprofile,
         AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusage,
         COUNT(*) AS telescope_count
  FROM filtered
  GROUP BY weathprofile
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_bandusage) AS mean_avg FROM profile_stats
)
SELECT p.weathprofile,
       p.avg_bandusage,
       p.telescope_count,
       p.avg_bandusage - o.mean_avg AS deviation_from_mean
FROM profile_stats p
CROSS JOIN overall o
WHERE o.mean_avg IS NOT NULL;
